coverage_scope: aggregate token frequency; per-request fallback rules unchanged

heldout_history_guard_cpu_replay.scope: held-out repository text tokenized as whole files and divided into disjoint chunks; no generated model output or GPU projection was tested

binding.native_manifest_source: retained /status from this verified formal installation; no model inference launched for generation

corpus_provenance.selection: tracked root README/DEVELOPMENT/INFERENCE_PARAMETERS, direct docs/*.md, dev/benchmarks/docs/*.md, runtime/server/install text sources; excludes docs/data, builds, models, chat records and external files
corpus_provenance.split: first four SHA-256 bytes of relative path, big endian, mod 5 == 0 held out; other files training

usage_scope: developer corpus seed; aggregate coverage does not establish arbitrary production-request coverage or measured acceleration
